title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: PiC (Pointcloud Interactive Computation) R package processing, segmentation, analysis terrestrial mobile laser scanning (TLS MLS) forest point-cloud data. provides fast voxel-based processing, classification point cloud forest floor, understory, wood canopy components, algorithms single-tree analysis stand-level structural characterization. methods designed handle large dense point clouds efficiently, supporting applications forest structure assessment, connectivity analysis, fire-risk evaluation. particular, Forest_seg() built large datasets: can process clouds ~600 million points (10 GB) workstation MacBook Pro M3 36 GB RAM, reasonable times — throughput roughly one million points per second. Input data provided .xyz, .txt, .las, .laz point-cloud files.

title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: Fast, memory-efficient voxelization large point clouds, native float coordinates single global coordinate shift numerical precision. Full forest segmentation forest floor, understory, wood, crown, non-valid trees, noise. Individual-tree metrics: position, height, DBH (multi-height, Pratt/Landau), crown base height (CBH). Plot-level metrics: tree density, basal area, crown understory volume, canopy coverage. Dedicated algorithms: LOR (Ligneous Object Recognition), DAV (Directional Anisotropy Vegetation), GAB (Geometrical Aggregation Biomass). Interactive Shiny interface parameter tuning 3D visualization. Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux); optional LAS/LAZ support.

title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: Load & shift — input coerced x, y, z table; global coordinate shift applied numerical precision (reversed outputs). Forest floor extraction — coarse/fine ground model (DTM) separates forest floor low vegetation -ground biomass (AGB). LOR (Ligneous Object Recognition) — woody points (trunks branches) identified. Tree detection & metrics — tree positions heights derived woody clusters. DBH — diameter breast height fitted multiple heights. DAV (Directional Anisotropy Vegetation) — foliage split crown understory. GAB (Geometrical Aggregation Biomass) — crown base height (CBH) estimated. Output — classified point cloud, reports, parameters log written.

title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: — input point cloud: file path (.xyz/.txt/.las/.laz) data.frame/data.table least 3 columns (x, y, z). Required. filename — output file prefix (default "XXX"); e.g. "plot_001" → plot_001_tree_report.csv. integer_precision — coordinate rounding precision, "mm" (3 decimals, high-resolution TLS) "cm" (2 decimals, lighter MLS/UAV). Default "mm". output_format — "las" (single classified LAS file, default) "xyz" (one plain-text file per class). output_path — output directory (default tempdir()); created missing. generate_reports — write CSV reports parameters log (default TRUE). Vox_print / Woodpoints_print — export voxel grid (default FALSE) / wood points (default TRUE).

title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: dtm_coarse_res — coarse DTM grid size m (default 0.5); fine resolution set internally half . tolerance — vertical threshold DTM m (default 0.4); points within band classified forest floor.

title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: dimVox — voxel size cm (default 2). TLS: 2 cm; sparser data: larger. th — minimum points per voxel (default 2). eps — DBSCAN radius voxel units (default 2); metric distance ≈ eps × dimVox. mpts — DBSCAN minimum neighbours (default 9). h_trunk — minimum trunk length m (default 3); shorter clusters discarded (removes shrubs). N — minimum voxels per wood cluster (default 3000). w_linear — linearity/quality filter, 0–1 (default 0.5); higher = stricter cylindrical shape. h_rescue_min / h_rescue_max — normalized height band (m DTM) rescue pass (defaults 1 / 5).

title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: dbh_tolerance — vertical slice half-thickness m (default 0.05, .e. ±5 cm). dbh_max_rmse — maximum fitting RMSE cm (default 5). dbh_min_radius / dbh_max_radius — valid radius range m (defaults 0.025 / 0.5, .e. ≈ 5–100 cm DBH). Internal (exposed): dbh_heights = c(1.3, 1.8, 2.3) m, dbh_min_points = 8.

title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: canopy_vox_dim — DAV voxel size m (default 0.15). canopy_min_density — minimum canopy density pts/m³ (default 500; shared CBH step). dav_understory_max_start — maximum start height understory m (default 1.3). dav_height_factor / dav_median_height_factor — internal DAV thresholds based median tree height (defaults 0.8 / 0.50). dav_eps / dav_minPts — DBSCAN parameters DAV (defaults 2 / 4).

title: PiC – Pointcloud Interactive Computation
text: calculate_cbh — enable CBH estimation (default TRUE). cbh_hex_side — hexagon edge length m (default 0.15). cbh_min_branch_length — minimum horizontal foliage extent m (default 2.0). cbh_save_points — save CBH points (default TRUE). Internal (auto-calculated): minimum cluster cells minimum points per cell (cbh_hex_side, canopy_vox_dim, canopy_min_density); vertical gap tolerance core count.

title: Forest floor segmentation with DTM validation — Floseg
text: Segments input point cloud forest floor -ground biomass (AGB) using two-stage DTM approach: 1. Create coarse DTM (e.g., 0.5m resolution) outlier removal gap filling 2. Interpolate fine DTM_small (0.1m resolution) filled coarse DTM 3. Extract points within vertical tolerance DTM_small surface approach robust sloped irregular terrain.

what: Forest component segmentation, plot and tree metrics — Forest_seg
title: Forest component segmentation, plot and tree metrics — Forest_seg
text: Forest_seg() main end--end routine package. takes raw terrestrial mobile laser scanning (TLS/MLS) point cloud runs complete eight-stage pipeline reconstructs forest floor, recognises woody structures, measures individual trees, separates crown understory, writes fully classified point clouds together per-tree per-plot reports reproducibility log. processing performed native float coordinates. single global shift applied start numerical precision reversed end, output coordinates returned original reference system. wood crown analysis relies three dedicated algorithms, LOR (Ligneous Object Recognition), DAV (Directional Anisotropy Vegetation) GAB (Geometrical Aggregation Biomass), described Details section.

title: Forest component segmentation, plot and tree metrics — Forest_seg
text: Processing pipeline (8 stages) Load shift - input (data frame .xyz /     .txt / .las / .laz file) coerced     x, y, z table global coordinate shift applied. Forest floor extraction - coarse/fine ground model (DTM)     separates forest floor low vegetation -ground biomass     (AGB). LOR (Ligneous Object Recognition) - woody points (trunks     branches) identified. Tree detection metrics - tree positions heights     derived woody clusters. DBH - diameter breast height fitted multiple heights. DAV (Directional Anisotropy Vegetation) - foliage split     tree crown understory. GAB (Geometrical Aggregation Biomass) - crown base height     (CBH) estimated. Output - classified point cloud, reports log     written. Point classification scheme Every point assigned integer class, consistent codes stored classified LAS file: 2 Forest floor (ground / vegetal soil) 3 Understory (low vegetation shrubs crown) 4 Wood (trunks branches) 5 Crown / foliage 6 Non-valid trees (clusters failed DBH validation) 7 Noise (isolated non-classifiable points) LOR - Ligneous Object Recognition (stage 3) AGB points voxelised (dimVox, th) grouped density-based clustering (DBSCAN, parameters eps / mpts). Clusters kept woody structures exceed minimum size (N), satisfy linearity/quality filter (w_linear) reach minimum trunk length (h_trunk). dedicated rescue pass (h_rescue_min-h_rescue_max) recovers woody points height band trunks low branches often missed. DAV - Directional Anisotropy Vegetation (stage 6) remaining foliage voxelised canopy_vox_dim filtered minimum density (canopy_min_density). Voxels clustered (dav_eps / dav_minPts) split crown understory using adaptive height threshold derived median tree height (dav_height_factor, dav_median_height_factor, capped dav_understory_max_start). Low vegetation forest floor stage assigned directly understory. voxel classification mapped back original points, crown understory volumes accumulated plot report. GAB - Geometrical Aggregation Biomass / CBH (stage 7) calculate_cbh = TRUE, crown wood voxels merged spatial continuity projected onto hexagonal tessellation (cbh_hex_side). foliage cell assigned nearest tree Voronoi partitioning voxel coordinates, breadth-first connectivity trace (trunk branches foliage) identifies lowest continuously foliated branch, whose height reported crown base height. step runs parallel across available cores. minimum foliage extent (cbh_min_branch_length) guards spurious detections. DBH measurement (stage 5) Diameter estimated circle fitting (Pratt/Landau) horizontal slices 1.3 m, fallbacks 1.8 m 2.3 m. fit accepted within radius range (dbh_min_radius-dbh_max_radius) maximum RMSE (dbh_max_rmse); trees failing heights flagged non-valid (class 6). Outputs Classified point cloud - default single classified LAS     file (output_format = "las") carrying class codes ;     output_format = "xyz" one plain-text file per class written     instead. Tree report (<filename>_tree_report.csv) - one row per     tree: identifier, class, position (X, Y, Z), height, DBH RMSE,     validity flag, CBH computed. Plot report (<filename>_plot_report.csv) - stand-level     statistics including tree density, basal area, crown understory     volume, canopy coverage. CBH diagnostics - per-tree CBH details, written     calculate_cbh = TRUE. Parameters log - complete record every parameter (exposed     internal), input summary, coordinate shift,     software/system versions timing, full reproducibility. Report log writing controlled generate_reports. Fixed internal parameters (exposed interface) dtm_fine_res: automatically set dtm_coarse_res / 2 dbh_heights: fixed c(1.3, 1.8, 2.3) metres dbh_min_points: fixed 8 (works well Pratt     Landau fitting)

what: Single Tree Wood-Leaf Segmentation and Comprehensive Metrics Calculation — SegOne
title: Single Tree Wood-Leaf Segmentation and Comprehensive Metrics Calculation — SegOne
text: Performs wood-leaf segmentation calculates comprehensive structural metrics individual trees terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) point cloud data. Version 4.2 uses shared_utils.R functions code reuse consistency Forest_seg pipeline. analysis follows four-stage processing pipeline: Voxelization wood component identification using DBSCAN clustering Foliage separation voxel-based subtraction Tree structural metrics calculation (height, DBH, crown base) Canopy volume quantification using density-weighted voxel analysis

title: Single Tree Wood-Leaf Segmentation and Comprehensive Metrics Calculation — SegOne
text: Input point cloud data. Can either: (1) data frame x, y, z coordinates, (2) file path .txt .xyz file containing point cloud data filename Character string specifying output file prefix (default: "Elab_single_tree") dimVox Numeric value specifying voxel dimension centimeters wood segmentation. Typical range: 1-5 cm. Smaller values increase computational cost improve spatial resolution (default: 2) th Integer specifying minimum number points required generate voxel. Used filter noise low-density regions (default: 2) eps Numeric value specifying epsilon neighborhood radius DBSCAN clustering voxel units. Determines spatial connectivity wood clusters (default: 2) mpts Integer specifying minimum number points required epsilon neighborhood voxel considered core point DBSCAN algorithm (default: 6) N Integer specifying minimum number voxels required form valid wood cluster. Filters small non-wood clusters (default: 1000) R Numeric threshold cluster shape parameter (standard deviation proportion variance PCA). Used identify cylindrical/linear wood structures. Higher values restrictive (default: 30) output_path Character string specifying directory path output files. directory exist, created (default: tempdir()) calculate_metrics Logical flag indicating whether calculate comprehensive tree metrics. title: Single Tree Wood-Leaf Segmentation and Comprehensive Metrics Calculation — SegOne
text: ## Processing Pipeline **Stage 1: Wood Segmentation** Wood components identified multi-step process: Point cloud voxelization resolution specified dimVox DBSCAN clustering applied voxel centroids using eps mpts Principal Component Analysis (PCA) filtering identify cylindrical structures Retention clusters shape parameter R exceeding threshold (cylindrical wood) PCA-based filtering exploits geometric properties tree stems branches, exhibit high first principal component values due elongated structure. **Stage 2: Foliage Separation** Foliage points extracted using voxel-based subtraction: wood total point cloud voxelized 0.2 m resolution Wood-occupied voxels identified Non-wood voxels retained mapped back original points approach ensures complete spatial separation wood foliage components. **Stage 3: Structural Metrics Calculation** calculate_metrics = TRUE, following metrics computed: **Tree Base Location (X, Y, Z_min)**: Coordinates lowest wood point **Tree Height**: Vertical distance base highest point within 1 m buffer **DBH (Diameter Breast Height)**: Calculated 1.3 m using Pratt circle     fitting algorithm +/- 5 cm tolerance. Valid range: 5-300 cm. DBH value     always reported CSV output. DBH_RMSE_cm column provides fit quality (max 5 cm     validation). DBH_valido flag indicates whether measurement meets quality standards. **Crown Base Height**: Detected using vertical density analysis filter     noise, followed gap analysis. Uses 0.5 m bins minimum 3 points per bin.     Valid range: 0.5 m 90 **Stage 4: Canopy Volume Quantification** Canopy volume metrics calculated using density-weighted voxel analysis: Foliage points voxelized resolution voxel_size_canopy Point density calculated per voxel Coverage degree computed using specified coverage_method Two volume metrics calculated: **Canopy Volume**: Total occupied voxel volume (m^3) **Occupied Volume**: Density-weighted volume accounting point distribution Coverage area computed ground projection occupied voxels (mq) ## Improvements Version 2.0 **Enhanced Crown Base Calculation:** Vertical density analysis filters noise points (isolated points near trunk) Uses 0.5 m vertical bins minimum 3 points per bin threshold Combines density filtering gap analysis robust detection Validates results multiple criteria **Improved DBH Validation:** Updated maximum diameter 3.0 m (300 cm) large/monumental trees RMSE quality check (max 5 cm) used flag poor circle fits DBH value always reported (even RMSE threshold exceeded) DBH_RMSE_cm column provides fit quality indicator DBH_valido flag indicates whether measurement meets quality standards Enhanced diagnostic messages showing fit quality ## Coverage Degree Methods coverage_method parameter determines point density translated coverage degree: **linear**: Linear normalization column maximum: \(CD = N / N_{max}\) **mean_normalized**: Normalization mean density: \(CD = N / \bar{N}\) **exponential**: Exponential saturation: \(CD = 1 - exp(-N / \bar{N})\) **threshold**: Binary classification 50th percentile **mediterranean**: Power-law scaling optimized sparse Mediterranean canopies:     \(CD = (N / N_{max})^{0.7}\) single trees, "linear" recommended provides intuitive interpretation point density relative maximum observed density. ## Quality Assurance function implements several validation checks: DBH validation: radius 2.5-150 cm, minimum 5 points, RMSE reported (< 5 cm valid flag) Crown base validation: density filtering, minimum 0.5 m, maximum 90 Point count validation: sufficient points measurement zones Comprehensive error handling diagnostic messages ## Output Files Two files generated output_path: **Classified LAS**: <filename>_eps<eps>_mpts<mpts>.las Class 4 = wood points, Class 5 = foliage points Single file replaces two legacy .txt outputs **Metrics**: <filename>_metrics.csv (calculate_metrics = TRUE) Contains calculated structural metrics DBH_cm: Always populated calculation succeeds DBH_RMSE_cm: Fit quality indicator (lower better, <5 cm valid) Semicolon-delimited format

title: PiC 3.3
text: New function metrics_from_las(): recomputes tree- plot-level metrics (DBH, height, crown base height, plot statistics) already classified point cloud (LAS ASPRS classes ground = 2, understory = 3, wood = 4, crown = 5), without repeating full Forest_seg() segmentation. New function pic_analyze_cloud(): pre-processing diagnostic tool assesses point-cloud quality structure (point density per m^2, voxel density distribution), returns plots interactive use optionally exports PDF report. loaded cloud stays memory subsequent Forest_seg() run. Forest_seg() plot report now includes crown_volume_m3 understory_volume_m3, computed final classified points (count occupied voxels canopy_vox_dim resolution times voxel volume) rounded whole cubic metres.

title: PiC 3.3
text: Crown base height (GAB): branch connectivity now uses direct vertical adjacency (gap-layer bridging). BFS keeps six lateral hexagonal neighbours, single empty layer now breaks branch instead bridged. CBH therefore reflects lowest foliated branch rather bridging upper crown. cbh_max_gap_layers retained backward compatibility longer used. also considers pure-noise voxels (cls == 0), rejected clusters; h_trunk_factor clamped [0.3, 1.0], rescue never stricter base pass height; DBSCAN minPts halved, sparse noise can re-cluster; stricter linearity threshold base pass applied (low trunk-band segments must linear), avoid admitting bushes. output_format: LAS default; value "xyz" falls back LAS. Report CSVs keep dot (.) decimal separator international use; crown/understory volumes written whole cubic metres. Removed Crown Packing Index (CPI) unused internal helper .analyze_canopy_float(), never wired pipeline. Removed unused internal helper .assign_components_bfs_float().

title: PiC 3.3
text: Fixed voxel--point reclassification (DAV) fail DAV step returned early without H_threshold value; now falls back dav_understory_max_start. Documented parameter defaults now match function signature. Internal helper .lor_create_voxels() marked internal longer appears package help index.

title: PiC 3.3
text: Updated defaults Forest_seg(): N = 3000 h_rescue_max = 5 dbh_max_radius = 0.5 canopy_min_density = 500 dav_understory_max_start = 1.3 dav_eps = 2 dav_minPts = 4 dbh_heights = c(1.3, 1.8, 2.3) (fixed internal parameter)
